messages:
Sri: Thinking about adding a small header to help the Console attribute quota usage per-request so we can show hosted vs dedicated token delta.
Marta: +1 on visibility. What's the exact header shape? Any SDK break risk?
Will: Proposed header: X-RW-Quota-Attr: team=eng;mode=hosted;sample=0.01
Will: Example curl: curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"X-RW-Quota-Attr: team=eng;mode=hosted;sample=1\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Toni (py-sdk): If it's optional it's non-breaking. We should add a Client param (quota_attr) so people don't have to set headers manually.
Jas (ts-sdk): TS will do the same. Accept client-level and per-call quotaAttr. If users set headers manually we won't overwrite them.
Sam: Sampling concern: if sample=1 everywhere we'll flood ingestion. Default must be tiny (server-side override possible).
Marta: Console wants a small "quota delta" card per-org/hour showing estimated tokens moved to dedicated vs hosted. Backend needs aggregated tokenDelta by team.
Will: Metric suggestion: rwi.quota.delta with tags mode and team. Agree?
Sri: OK but align tag names with existing cloud telemetry (use cost_center for team). Will draft mapping table.
Toni (py-sdk): Py sketch:
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=..., quota_attr={"team":"eng","mode":"hosted","sample":1})
# per-call override
c.generate(prompt, quota_attr={"sample":1})

Toni: Implementation will serialize to X-RW-Quota-Attr with semicolon-delimited pairs and sanitize values. Default None -> no header.
Jas (ts-sdk): TS sketch:
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, quotaAttr: { team: 'eng' } });
client.generate({ prompt, quotaAttr: { sample: 1 } });

Jas: we'll add runtime asserts to prevent invalid chars and unit tests for header output.
Marta: Security: server must validate that the provided team matches the API key/account. If mismatch, tag as attribution=invalid and increment a metric.
Sam: Finance: need to sign off if this feeds billing or chargeback. I'll ping finance and legal.
Sri: Rollout plan: 1) server accepts header but ignores it by default; 2) SDKs add opt-in quota_attr param behind ENV_RW_QUOTA_ATTR_OPTIN; 3) server respects sample but can override with server-side sampling; 4) canary orgs can enable full sampling.
DevBot: Reminder: create RFC doc and link PRs to rfc/quota-attr by EOD Fri.
Toni (py-sdk): I'll open Py PR behind env flag with tests + changelog. ETA Tue.
Jas (ts-sdk): I'll open TS PR Wed and pair on tests with Toni.
Will: I'll prototype the Console tile with mock metrics on a canary org.
Marta: Eng-platform: please add compatibility note for proxies (header size/strip issues) and allowed keys. Also call out that proxies may drop unknown headers unless pass-through configured.
Sri: Server will validate and reject/spoof-check. If invalid attribution we'll mark it and continue without failing the request.
Marta: Action items recap: Toni PR, Jas PR, Will console mock + mapping, Sam ping finance/legal, Sri server validation spec. Thanks all :thumbsup:
